'''Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang''' operated on the planet of [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] and its [[Telerath's second moon|second moon]]. Led by [[Ken-Kiba]], the gang was considered by some to be more dangerous than its rival - [[Musori's gang]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Dass Jennir]], [[Skirmish on Telerath|attacked]] the gang's [[Unidentified Telerath moon base|operation]] on the moon. He freed all the enslaved individuals, consisting of [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] and [[Chubbit]]s, and killing all the gangsters who stood in his way.
